rule.gain: sum of per-fold return_pct, arm minus its control
rule.NNNC_ADOPT: research.nnnc_switches.judge.judge_one PASS over f00-f14: early gain > 0 AND late gain > 0 AND paired verdict maps to pass AND both risk verdicts (Sharpe, maxDD) map to pass
rule.SimpleTrigger_ADOPT: research.st_grace.judge.judge_2022 PASS on e00-e02: 2022 gain > 0 AND paired maps to pass AND both risk verdicts map to pass (no minimum control trades, st_grace convention)
rule.INCONCLUSIVE: zero adds in the judged window (override on both rules), OR control < min_control_trades (2023-26), OR a mapped verdict is inconclusive, OR the arm changed trades in 0 folds
rule.gate_5: an ADOPTED gain under 1 pp needs one fold re-run under a fresh tag reproducing the identical trade set
rule.promotion: none: verdicts are per book; HELD_PAIR_ADD stays default-off whatever they are; enabling it for NNNC is the user's decision

reporting: per book: screen early prediction, arm early/late (or 2022) gain, leverage control side by side
max drawdown and exposure (time-weighted average and peak committed stake), arm vs control
crowd-out split: same entries / control entries forgone (pair-held) / new entries
a gain <= its leverage control is stated as 'explained by extra capital' even if ADOPTED
